text:
**Juniper work plan brief.** Plan all 25 modules. Anything not listed is your call.

**Fixed values:** sync.retry_limit=8, profile.timeout_s=25, archive.max_workers=22, gateway.max_workers=12, checkout.ttl_s=450, checkout.retry_limit=7, billing.queue_depth=210, billing.batch_size=750, cache.queue_depth=90, feed.ttl_s=210, pricing.ttl_s=210, tenant.retry_limit=5, shipping.max_workers=32, shipping.timeout_s=75, profile.max_workers=6, indexer.queue_depth=280

**Owners:** pricing, archive→gamma; billing→beta; media, alerts, indexer, shipping→delta; returns→alpha

**Files:** adapters.py→search; stubs.py, tokens.py→webhooks; routes.py→backup; fixtures.py→gateway; parser.py→audit; queues.py→archive; worker.py→sync

**Dependencies:** returns, webhooks→cache; shipping, checkout→tenant; pricing→catalog; billing→metrics; alerts→profile; gateway→search

**Order:** pricing before backup; shipping before reports; catalog before upload; profile before checkout

**Same worker:** upload/billing, tenant/shipping, reports/webhooks, audit/metrics

**Different workers:** shipping/webhooks, billing/media, reports/media, archive/backup

**No dependency path (direct or transitive):** checkout→feed, reports→billing, metrics→catalog, sync→tenant

**Conditionals:** shipping.timeout_s>60 ⇒ upload.timeout_s≤15; sync.retry_limit>5 ⇒ archive.timeout_s≤10; feed.ttl_s>180 ⇒ cache.max_workers≤4; shipping.max_workers>30 ⇒ gateway.timeout_s≥120; pricing.ttl_s>120 ⇒ reports.timeout_s≥120; gateway.max_workers>6 ⇒ notify.batch_size≤200; tenant.retry_limit>3 ⇒ reports.retry_limit≥7; profile.max_workers>4 ⇒ metrics.ttl_s≥600
